buildings.name: Air Center
buildings.description: Increase your overall aircraft hero stats with the air center. Upgrading this also gives you a larger march speed for the aircraft heroes.

buildings.name: Alert Tower
buildings.description: Defines the level of your scout planes and what they will be able to see when scouting other commanders. Higher levels unlock more advanced scout reports.

buildings.name: Alliance Center
buildings.description: Allows you to join or create alliances. Higher levels increase the number of alliance helps you can receive.

buildings.name: Armament Institute
buildings.description: Allows you to research 4 Armaments for your troops to unlock T11 troops.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Train and upgrade your troops in the barracks. Higher levels unlock more advanced troop types and increase training amounts.

buildings.name: Builder's Hut
buildings.description: A cosy home for your builders. Higher levels increase the default time reduction for building upgrades.

buildings.name: Chip Lab
buildings.description: Allows you to craft drone skill chips from materials. Higher levels unlock legendary chips.

buildings.name: Coin Vault
buildings.description: Protects your coins from being stolen. Higher levels increase the amount of coins that can be protected.

buildings.name: Component Factory
buildings.description: Produces drone components to upgrade your drone equipment. Higher levels increase component production rate.

buildings.name: Drill Ground
buildings.description: House your troops at the drill ground. Higher levels increase the number of troops that can be stationed here.

buildings.name: Drone Parts Workshop
buildings.description: Produces drone parts for your drone. Higher levels increase the amount of drone parts produced.

buildings.name: Emergency Center
buildings.description: The emergency center is an additional hospital that takes care of troops that would otherwise be lost. Higher levels increase the number of troops that can be healed in your emergency center before being full.

buildings.name: Farmland
buildings.description: Produces food for you. Higher levels increase food production rate.

buildings.name: Food Warehouse
buildings.description: Protects your food from being stolen. Higher levels increase the amount of food that can be protected.

buildings.name: Gear Factory
buildings.description: Craft gear for your heroes and merge materials into higher tier materials. Higher levels unlock better gear to be crafted.

buildings.name: Gold Mine
buildings.description: Produces gold for you. Higher levels increase gold production rate.

buildings.name: Headquarters
buildings.description: Your central building that defines your level. Upgrading this unlocks additional buildings, as well as general power increases and additional hero levels.

buildings.name: Hospital
buildings.description: Injured troops are sent here instead of being lost. Higher levels increase the number of troops that can be healed in your hospital before being full.

buildings.name: Iron Mine
buildings.description: Generates iron for you. Higher levels increase iron production rate.

buildings.name: Iron Warehouse
buildings.description: Protects your iron from being stolen. Higher levels increase the amount of iron that can be protected.

buildings.name: Material Workshop
buildings.description: Produces screws which can be combined into other materials in your gear factory. Higher levels increase screw production rate.

buildings.name: Missile Center
buildings.description: Increase your overall missile hero stats with the missile center. Upgrading this also gives you a larger march speed for the missile heroes.

buildings.name: Oil Well
buildings.description: Generates oil for you. Higher levels increase oil production rate.

buildings.name: Recon Plane
buildings.description: Allows you to scout other players. Higher levels increase the speed at which your planes move.

buildings.name: Smelter
buildings.description: Generates ore for upgrading your hero gear. Higher levels increase ore production rate.

buildings.name: Squad
buildings.description: Allows you to create squads of heroes. Higher levels increase the march speed of the specific squad.

buildings.name: Tactical Institute
buildings.description: Produces training guidebooks for your overlord (gorilla). Higher levels increase the amount of training guidebooks produced.

buildings.name: Tank Center
buildings.description: Increase your overall tank hero stats with the tank center. Upgrading this also gives you a larger march speed for the tank heroes.

buildings.name: Tavern
buildings.description: Recruit heroes and survivors in the tavern. Higher levels decrease the time for free recruitments.

buildings.name: Tech Center
buildings.description: With the tech center you can unlock a variety of researches that will all around improve your base. From buffs to reduce construction times to various attack and defense buffs.

buildings.name: Training Base
buildings.description: Provides hero experience for your heroes. Higher levels increase the amount of experience gained.

buildings.name: Wall
buildings.description: The wall defines how quickly your base gets damaged when on fire and how quickly it can restore to full health. Higher levels also reduce the casualty rate of troops when breached.

buildings.name: Air Force Base (S1)
buildings.description: Provides additional stats to your aircraft heroes. It is an extension to your existing Air Center building.

buildings.name: Missile Base (S1)
buildings.description: Provides additional stats to your missile heroes. It is an extension to your existing Missile Center building.

buildings.name: Protein Farm
buildings.description: Produces protein for you. Higher levels increase protein production rate. Protein is a seasonal resource used for building and upgrading seasonal buildings.

buildings.name: Tank Base (S1)
buildings.description: Provides additional stats to your tank heroes. It is an extension to your existing Tank Center building.

buildings.name: Virus Research Institute
buildings.description: Increases your virus resistance. Higher levels increase the amount of virus resistance.

buildings.name: Air Force Base (S2)
buildings.description: Provides additional stats to your aircraft heroes. It is an extension to your existing Air Center building.

buildings.name: High-Heat Furnace
buildings.description: Advanced thermal processing facility that generates extreme heat for industrial operations. Higher levels increase virus resistance and heat generation capabilities.

buildings.name: Missile Base (S2)
buildings.description: Provides additional stats to your missile heroes. It is an extension to your existing Missile Center building.

buildings.name: Tank Base (S2)
buildings.description: Provides additional stats to your tank heroes. It is an extension to your existing Tank Center building.

buildings.name: Titanium Alloy Factory
buildings.description: Industrial facility that produces titanium alloy from coal resources. Higher levels increase titanium output rate for advanced construction projects.

buildings.name: Altar
buildings.description: Once built it provides additional stats boosts to your protectors.

buildings.name: Blessing Fountain
buildings.description: Provides you with sacred water for seasonal upgrades. Higher levels increase the amount of water produced per hour.

buildings.name: Curse Research Lab
buildings.description: Your own labratory to research the mysterious curse that has taken over the world. Higher levels increase your curse resistance and unlocks further upgrades for other seasonal buildings.

buildings.name: Protector's Field (S3)
buildings.description: Advanced defensive structure that houses and enhances protectors. Increases protector limits and provides combat bonuses.

buildings.name: Optoelectronic Lab
buildings.description: Advanced laboratory for optoelectronic research and development. Increases max brightness and virus resistance capabilities.

buildings.name: Protector's Field (S4)
buildings.description: Advanced defensive structure that houses and enhances protectors. Increases protector limits and provides combat bonuses.

buildings.name: Quartz Workshop
buildings.description: Produces quartz for upgrading season 4 buildings. Higher levels increase quartz production rate.

buildings.name: Lighthouse
buildings.description: Strategic beacon that provides power capacity and assistance to your base operations.

buildings.name: Caffeine Institute
buildings.description: Institute for coffee research and development. Generates Special Coffee and increases virus resistance capabilities. Important: Virus Resistance and Coffee requirements differ for new (69+) and older (3-68) servers!

buildings.name: Coffee Factory
buildings.description: Produces coffee for upgrading season 5 buildings. Higher levels increase coffee production rate.

buildings.name: Missileer Bar
buildings.description: Boosts your missile heroes' stats during Season 5.

buildings.name: Pilot Bar
buildings.description: Boosts your aircraft heroes' stats during Season 5.

buildings.name: Protector's Field (S5)
buildings.description: Advanced defensive structure that houses and enhances protectors. Increases protector limits and provides combat bonuses.

buildings.name: Tanker Bar
buildings.description: Boosts your tank heroes' stats during Season 5.

buildings.name: Bear Totem
buildings.description: Boosts your tank heroes' stats during Season 6.

buildings.name: Eagle Totem
buildings.description: Boosts your aircraft heroes' stats during Season 6.

buildings.name: Fungus Institute
buildings.description: Institute for fungal research and development. Generates Spores and increases virus resistance capabilities.

buildings.name: Jaguar Totem
buildings.description: Boosts your missile heroes' stats during Season 6.

buildings.name: Protector's Field (S6)
buildings.description: Advanced defensive structure that houses and enhances protectors. Increases protector limits and provides combat bonuses.

buildings.name: Spore Factory
buildings.description: Produces Rainforest Mushrooms for upgrading season 6 buildings. Higher levels increase mushroom production rate.
